name_zh: 格鲁吉亚·斯大林：苏联化与格鲁吉亚本土化
description_zh: 约瑟夫·斯大林 (1878-1953) 生于格鲁吉亚哥里，作为苏联最高领导人推行全面苏联化政策，同时在格鲁吉亚实施本土化策略，培养格鲁吉亚籍干部，推广格鲁吉亚语言文化，形成独特的格鲁吉亚式斯大林主义。
description_en: Joseph Stalin (1878-1953) born in Gori, Georgia, as Soviet supreme leader implemented comprehensive Sovietization policies while pursuing indigenization in Georgia, cultivating Georgian cadres, promoting Georgian language and culture, creating a unique Georgian-style Stalinism.
reason_zh: 斯大林是格鲁吉亚裔苏联领袖，其统治展示了帝国中心与边缘民族地区的复杂互动，既是苏联化的推行者又是格鲁吉亚本土化的受益者，体现高加索地区在苏联体制中的特殊地位。
reason_en: Stalin as Georgian-origin Soviet leader demonstrates complex interaction between imperial center and peripheral ethnic regions - both driver of Sovietization and beneficiary of Georgian indigenization, embodying Caucasus special status in Soviet system.
steps_zh: 分析斯大林早年格鲁吉亚革命经历与马克思主义接受
研究1920s格鲁吉亚本土化政策与语言文化推广
探讨斯大林清洗中格鲁吉亚精英的命运
评估二战时期格鲁吉亚作为后方基地的贡献
总结斯大林死后格鲁吉亚去斯大林化与民族记忆
steps_en: Analyze Stalin early Georgian revolutionary experience and Marxist adoption
Study 1920s Georgian indigenization policies and language-culture promotion
Explore fate of Georgian elites during Stalin purges
Evaluate Georgia contribution as rear base during WWII
Summarize post-Stalin de-Stalinization in Georgia and ethnic memory
expected_zh: 理解斯大林作为格鲁吉亚裔苏联领袖的双重身份张力，掌握苏联化与本土化在高加索地区的辩证关系，评估其对后苏联时代格鲁吉亚民族认同的深远影响。
expected_en: Understand the dual identity tension of Stalin as Georgian-origin Soviet leader, grasp the dialectic of Sovietization and indigenization in the Caucasus, evaluate its profound impact on post-Soviet Georgian national identity.
case_zh: 1921 斯大林任格鲁吉亚事务人民委员，推行本土化；1930s 大清洗中格鲁吉亚精英大量遇害；1941-1945 格鲁吉亚作为苏联后方提供 70 万士兵；1953 斯大林死后格鲁吉亚爆发反苏示威。苏联化与本土化辩证张力永存。
case_en: 1921 Stalin as Peoples Commissar for Georgian Affairs promoted indigenization; 1930s Great Purge decimated Georgian elites; 1941-1945 Georgia as Soviet rear provided 700K soldiers; 1953 post-Stalin Georgia erupted in anti-Soviet protests. Sovietization-indigenization dialectical tension endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Sovietization driver; Georgian indigenization beneficiary; Caucasus special status in Soviet system
